mapper.select: SELECT id FROM place WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'public'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (user_id, place_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{placeId}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT pk_favorite DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT p.slug, p.name, p.category, p.subtype, p.address, p.image_url, p.opening_hours, ST_Y(p.location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(p.location::geometry) AS longitude, NULL::int AS distance_m FROM favorite f JOIN place p ON p.id = f.place_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'public' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, p.id
